# Monster

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Terminology](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#Monster)*

A monster is a creature controlled by the DM, even if the creature is benevolent. *See also* "[Creature](Creature.md)" and "[NPC](Nonplayer-Character.md)."
